long_biography.plain_text:
Marc A. Menowitz entered business through automation. He earned an MBA from the University of Southern California, then worked on field, service and factory systems. He later launched a management company that used tracking technology to improve inventory, logistics and workflow. Those methods became his entry point into the Menowitz family's fourth-generation real-estate platform.

As chief executive of ApartmentCorp, Menowitz leads a privately held business focused on affordable and conventional multifamily housing, value-added acquisitions and property management across the United States. His operating approach combines real-estate investment with process technology. He led the development of Property MAX AI, a platform that tracks maintenance, staffing, inventory and service performance across apartment portfolios. The system extends the same automation discipline he developed earlier in his career.
